stable_production_domain.rule: Must be the real stable HTTPS production domain. Localhost, example, preview, staging, test and development domains are rejected.

tls_evidence_artifact.rule: Real TLS evidence for the stable production domain must exist; this collector does not perform or substitute a live TLS probe.

environment_configuration_receipt_withou.rule: A production environment configuration receipt must prove required configuration names/readiness without containing secret values.

release_commit_sha.rule: The exact production release commit must be independently identified and bound to the remaining evidence.

production_smoke_test_receipt.rule: A real production smoke-test receipt must exist for the exact release. Preparation cannot manufacture or replay a production proof.

rollback_test_receipt.rule: A real rollback test receipt must prove rollback readiness for the production release.

monitoring_alerting_readiness_receipt.rule: A full monitoring/alerting readiness receipt must exist. Stage35 alert delivery proof alone is insufficient for this production gate.

backup_restore_readiness_reference_artif.rule: A reviewed backup/restore readiness reference must exist and be bound to the release context.

release_evidence_manifest_artifact.rule: A final release evidence manifest must bind the domain, TLS, configuration, release SHA, smoke, rollback, monitoring/alerting and backup/restore evidence.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: COLLECT_DIGEST_ONLY_RECEIPT
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Hash real production release/operations artifacts and record only non-sensitive metadata. No network, deployment or database mutation.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: INDEPENDENTLY_REVIEW_RECEIPT_AND_SOURCE_ARTIFACTS
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Confirm domain/TLS binding, secret-free environment receipt, exact release SHA, smoke, rollback, monitoring/alerting, backup/restore and release manifest.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: PROMOTE_DEDICATED_EVIDENCE_MIGRATION
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Only after real independent review, create a separate versioned migration updating exactly production_deployment with evidence_ref and evidence_digest.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: MERGE_GREEN_THEN_APPLY_ONCE
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Apply the exact merged evidence migration through Supabase.apply_migration only; execute_sql remains SELECT-only.
